The koreader test runner (base/test-runner/runtests, kodev:659) is inside the not-checked-out base submodule, so the spore_spec.lua:62 row's test-time path is inferred from the specs' bare-name requires. Plugin rows: PluginLoader:_load prepends the plugin root while main.lua runs and restores the path afterwards (frontend/pluginloader.lua:242-244,269-270); none of the five plugin dirs involved has a ui/ subdirectory. luarocks.* rows: every run mode (installed script GNUmakefile:84-85/:96, in-tree wrappers :67/:75, all-in-one binary, busted harness) reaches the same src/luarocks/*.lua; luarocks.loader (src/luarocks/loader.lua:323) resolves only modules listed in rock manifests, and a make install is not a rock. I answered the vendored file because the documented build/install and the in-tree wrapper load it. configure --with-system-rocks, make bootstrap and the busted harness load a separately installed compat53 (not in the corpus) instead, and on Lua >= 5.3 the call never runs.
